gloss: KREP_VERSION; a file of another version errors on read
a text, numbered from 1 in the order the file gives them and held once, which a record names by its number: its count of bytes, then the bytes; every text comes before the first record

the who of the records after it to the next who: the source, its line and the program as the who table numbers them, sixteen bits each, then the time in nanoseconds since 1970 in UTC; of no numbers, no who is known of the records after it
a record of the file's format, the code its oracle gives: its count of numbers, then the numbers

every code, count, length and number written in as few bytes as it takes, seven bits a byte, the low bits first and the top bit set on every byte but its last; in memory each is a 64-bit word, compared as one

the head of a file a run is to write, a row of the table the format names handed critical, its sequence the file's key: the file's kind as a number, its four bytes the low first, the version, and the length and bytes of the file's name in the run
a text the file takes, in the order it takes them, of no who: its number, its length and its bytes
a record put at its place, every record from it on one later, the who in force over it its who: its code, its count of words and the words
a record given other words in its place: their count and the words
a record let go, every record past it one sooner

every number of a row a 64-bit word, the low byte first, and a row's bytes filled out to a whole word with zeros; a row is a blob of the table's name, its key the sequence of the file's head, and the file written is the file its rows put together in the order the run holds them
